test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question: Which of these can be inferred about the narrator?
solution:
The correct answer is **'He was observant'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The narrator noticed a great deal about the building and its atmosphere, including the open windows and the light from the candles.
 
• They paid close attention to the quietness and eeriness of the place, making them feel uneasy and reconsider their decision to proceed.
 
• They carefully observed the man coming out of the house, noting his hasty actions such as putting his watch back in his pocket.
 
• The narrator found it odd that the man did not shut the door behind him and noticed that he was looking behind him as if taking in all the details.
 
• They also observed the man's respectful gesture of raising his hat and his lack of surprise at meeting a stranger.
 
• The narrator noticed the inviting smell of food being cooked in the house, which further highlights their attentiveness to their surroundings.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• He was thankful: There is no specific mention of gratitude in the passage. 
 
• He was foolish: The narrator reconsidered their decision but ultimately decided to proceed, showing a reasonable level of caution.
 
• He was a coward: While the narrator felt uneasy, they still pushed forward towards the house, which does not indicate cowardice.
